name: Anker Soundcore R50i True Wireless Earbuds
shortDescription: TWS Earbuds with 10mm drivers, 30-hour battery life, IPX5 water resistance, and customize sound via Soundcore app.
longDescription: The Anker Soundcore R50i features big, punchy bass via its extra-large 10mm drivers, giving you an immersive listening experience. It's incredibly light and features an ergonomic shape, ensuring all-day comfort. With 10 hours of playtime on a single charge and up to 30 hours with the case, you'll never run out of music. It also offers fast charging—a quick 10-minute charge gives you 2 hours of playback.
pros: Outstanding deep bass and crisp vocals
Highly customizable EQ via Soundcore app
Excellent battery life with rapid charging
IPX5 rating offers reliable sweat & rain protection
cons: No Active Noise Cancellation (ANC)
Touch controls can occasionally be hypersensitive

name: Redmi Buds 5 Wireless Earbuds
shortDescription: 46dB Active Noise Cancelling earbuds with dual-mic AI noise reduction and up to 40 hours playtime.
longDescription: The Redmi Buds 5 delivers an incredible acoustic experience with 46dB Active Noise Cancellation (ANC). Block out background chatter and commute noise easily. It features an independent acoustic cavity, a 12.4mm dynamic driver with titanium-plated diaphragm, and 3 noise cancellation levels. With up to 40 hours of battery life with the charging case and quick charging, you're always ready.
pros: Amazing 46dB Active Noise Cancellation at this price point
Massive 12.4mm titanium-plated drivers for exceptional soundstage
Dual-microphone AI noise reduction for extremely clear calls
Google Fast Pair support
cons: The charging case has a slightly bulky square footprint
In-ear detection can feel slightly delayed

name: QCY T13 TWS Smart Earbuds
shortDescription: Budget-friendly king with 4 micro phones, ENC noise reduction, and ultra-fast charging.
longDescription: The QCY T13 has earned its reputation as the ultimate budget-friendly TWS earbuds in Pakistan. Packed with 4 high-definition ENC microphones, it filters out ambient noise to keep your voice clear and crisp during calls. Equipped with a 7.2mm dynamic driver and Bluetooth 5.1, it delivers premium, rich acoustics. Fully customizable through the QCY app.
pros: Extremely affordable with incredible cost-performance ratio
4-mic ENC system performs outstandingly in loud environments
Fully featured companion app support on iOS and Android
Snug, comfortable, and lightweight fit
cons: Plastic gloss case easily collects micro-scratches
The default bass profile might feel slightly flat without app EQ

name: Sony WH-CH520 Wireless Headset
shortDescription: Premium Sony on-ear headphones with up to 50 hours battery life, DSEE sound upscaling, and multipoint connection.
longDescription: Enjoy high sound quality all day long with the Sony WH-CH520. Featuring up to 50 hours of battery life, stable connectivity, and enhanced call performance, they meet all your daily listening requirements. The Digital Sound Enhancement Engine (DSEE) restores harmonics lost during compression, giving you rich, premium audio that is close to the original recording.
pros: Unbelievable 50-hour battery life keeps you going for days
Super comfortable lightweight design with plush earpads
DSEE upscales compressed audio files beautifuly
Crystal-clear hands-free calling with noise suppression
cons: On-ear design may feel warm after hours of continuous use
No physical 3.5mm headphone jack for wired listening

name: Baseus Bowie H1i Active Noise Cancelling Headphones
shortDescription: Over-ear ANC headphones featuring -38dB active noise cancellation, Hi-Res Audio certification, and 100h playback.
longDescription: The Baseus Bowie H1i features dual-channel active noise cancellation that effectively suppresses background noise up to -38dB. Enjoy high-resolution audio certified quality with LHDC support. What makes the H1i legendary is its astounding 100-hour battery life (with ANC off), meaning you only need to charge it once or twice a month!

specifications.Battery Life: Up to 100 Hours (ANC off) / 70 Hours (ANC on)

pros: Mind-blowing 100-hour maximum battery life
Officially Hi-Res certified with gorgeous clarity and response
Support for hybrid active noise cancellation
Includes a 3.5mm aux input port for analog wired playback
cons: The companion app requires creating an account for some features
Earcup hinges are fully plastic and require gentle handling

name: Sennheiser HD 206 Stereo Headphones
shortDescription: Classic over-ear audiophile headphones with dynamic stereo sound, powerful bass, and comfortable fit.
longDescription: The Sennheiser HD 206 is a pair of closed-back, dynamic stereo headphones for budget-conscious music lovers. Offering powerful sound reproduction, solid ambient noise attenuation, and outstanding comfort, they're perfect for listening to music, practicing instruments, or simple studio work in home environments.
pros: Sennheiser signature sound reproduction quality at a stellar price
Superb ambient isolation due to tight closed-back seal
Very lightweight design makes it suitable for extended wearing
Strong gold-plated 1/4" (6.3 mm) stereo jack adapter included
cons: Extra-long 3-meter cable can get easily tangled in travel setups
No built-in microphone or inline control buttons

name: Anker PowerPort III 20W Cube Charger
shortDescription: Ultra-compact 20W Power Delivery wall charger with foldable plug, ideal for high-speed charging of iPhone and Galaxy.
longDescription: PowerPort III 20W Cube is designed with a foldable plug to offer ultimate portability and convenience. Equipped with our legendary PowerIQ 3.0 technology, it delivers high-speed charging for your smartphone. Charge an iPhone 13/14 up to 50% in just 30 minutes—that's up to 3x faster than with an original 5W charger.
pros: Super compact cube body with collapsible premium prongs
Full compatibility with iPhones, iPads, and Samsung Super Fast Charge
MultiProtect safety system prevents overcharging and thermal spikes
Extremely robust built that withstands drop after drop
cons: Charging cable is not included in the retail box
Only has a single USB-C port, cannot charge multiple devices simultaneously

name: Ugreen Premium Braided USB-C to USB-C Cable (100W)
shortDescription: Heavy-duty double nylon braided fast-charging cable supporting Power Delivery 3.0 and QC 4.0 up to 100W.
longDescription: Ugreen's USB C to USB C cable supports Power Delivery up to 100W (20V/5A), allowing you to charge your MacBooks, laptops, tablets, and phones at lightning speeds. Double-braided premium nylon ensures a lifetime of heavy bends and pulls without cracking, while aluminum-alloy premium housing keeps connector joints highly stable.
pros: Heavy-duty 100W power delivery is great for laptops and flagship smartphones
Double nylon braid tested for over 10,000 full flex bends
High-grade built-in E-Marker intelligent safety chip
Exceptional tactile feel and robust connections
cons: Limits data sync to USB 2.0 (480Mbps) speed, not designed for high-resolution video transfer
Slightly stiff cord feel due to protective double braiding layers

name: Joyroom JR-T014 20000mAh Power Bank (15W)
shortDescription: 20000mAh external battery packs with LED status display, dual USB outputs, and Type-C input/output.
longDescription: The Joyroom JR-T014 is a massive 20000mAh capacity power bank designed to keep your devices charged during travel or power outages. With 15W high-speed charging capability and a clear digital smart screen, it monitors remaining energy accurately. Simultaneously charge up to three devices to share the power.
pros: Gigantic 20000mAh reserves can charge an average iPhone up to 4.5 times
Highly readable, precise digital percentage LED indicator
Allows charging 3 devices at the same time safely
Meets standard air travel safe power requirements
cons: Relatively heavy at 420 grams, adding weight to small daily bags
Takes around 6-7 hours to fully charge the power bank from empty

name: Logitech MX Master 2S Wireless Mouse
shortDescription: Premium productivity mouse with 4000-DPI Darkfield tracking, dual connectivity, and flow control.
longDescription: The Logitech MX Master 2S is the ultimate ergonomic productivity mouse. Features a precision speed-adaptive scroll wheel that auto-shifts from click-to-click to hyper-fast scrolling. Tracks seamlessly anywhere—even on glass! Utilize Logitech Flow to seamlessly navigate across three computers, copying and pasting files, text, and images between them.

specifications.Sensor Resolution: 200 to 4000 DPI (set in increments of 50 DPI)
specifications.Battery Life: Up to 70 days on a single full charge
specifications.Wireless Technology: Unifying USB Receiver or Bluetooth Smart

pros: Incredibly ergonomic contour shape relieves forearm strain
Advanced speed-adaptive dual-mode scroll wheel is highly satisfying
Logitech Flow allows absolute multi-computer control
Top-tier tracking sensor works flawlessly on glass tables
cons: Right-handed physical design ONLY, completely unsuited for left-handed professionals
Slightly heavy layout might not suit fast-twitch casual shooters

name: Redragon K552 KUMARA Mechanical Keyboard
shortDescription: Premium metal-built mechanical keyboard with dust-proof red/blue switches and gorgeous RGB lighting.
longDescription: The Redragon K552 Kumara is a tenkeyless compact mechanical keyboard featuring an industrial aircraft-grade aluminum and ABS casing. Outfitted with heavy-duty mechanical switches, it provides incredible tactile click and durability. Ideal for writers, programmers, and office workers seeking heavy tactile input feedback.
pros: Super solid metal frame body provides zero flex or wobble during heavy typist sessions
Double-shot injection molded keycaps never fade or chip
Brilliant, highly adjustable RGB patterns and speeds
N-key rollover anti-ghosting design ensures zero missed keystrokes
cons: Blue switch option makes loud clicks, might not be suitable for quiet open office zones
Has a thick, non-detachable USB cable

name: Ugreen Multi-Port 7-in-1 USB-C Hub Adapter
shortDescription: Stunning aluminum 7-in-1 hub with 4K HDMI, 100W Power Delivery, SD/TF Reader, and 2 USB 3.0 ports.
longDescription: Expand the functionality of your thin modern laptop using the Ugreen 7-in-1 Type-C hub. Finished in standard space gray aluminum, it incorporates a stunning 4K HDMI output for screens, a USB-C Power Delivery port supporting up to 100W, twin USB 3.0 SuperSpeed hubs, and a card reader, making it the perfect desktop companion.
pros: Sleek aluminum chassis dissipates heat efficiently
100W power delivery is high enough to charge top-tier laptops while hubbing
Both card reader slots can be read and written simultaneously
Zero driver installations required; pure plug-and-play
cons: HDMI is limited to 30Hz at 4K resolution (requires 1080p for full 60Hz)
Builds up mild heat during long, high-load transfers
